title: Classified Able Archer crisis felt inside Sandia Labs

tellings.quote: there was a Able Archer crisis of 1983, which was classified. We were as close to a nuclear war as we were during the Cuban Missile Crisis, but it was secret. Only people on the lab premises inside the fence knew how bad things were.

plain: In 1983 the world came as close to nuclear war as it did during the Cuban Missile Crisis, but the public never knew, according to the scientist John Brandenburg, who was working then at Sandia National Lab, a US government research laboratory in New Mexico. He calls it the Able Archer crisis and says it was kept secret: "Only people on the lab premises inside the fence knew how bad things were." He tells it from his own time at the lab, and if true it means a near brush with nuclear war was hidden from the public.
